Synopsis:
Baltic Sea nations are forming a joint drone-defence task force, announced by German Interior Minister Dobrindt ahead of a Flensburg ministerial meeting. The initiative is a direct response to escalating hybrid threats — sabotage of undersea cables and gas pipelines — since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. A drone carrying explosives was recently found at Leipzig/Halle Airport, a key military logistics hub, intensifying German security concerns. Dobrindt explicitly warned that hybrid attacks may intensify in coming months.
